# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# Independently written terminal resource-callsite diagnostic v2; no function execution.
import sys
START_PATH = tuple(sys.path)
REFUSAL_FLAG=False
ENTRY_GATE=False
RESOURCE_PATH="/usr/lib/python3.12/lib-dynload/resource.cpython-312-aarch64-linux-gnu.so"
RESOURCE_IDENT={"path":RESOURCE_PATH,"sha256":"2e1deb71ff45f48040851b25eb46d106baacbcd1804641105dce48f8ed278e44","size":68288,"mode":420,"mtime_ns":1781873160000000000}
RESOURCE_ROWS=[{"permissions":"r-xp","file_offset":"0x0"},{"permissions":"---p","file_offset":"0x3000"},{"permissions":"r--p","file_offset":"0xf000"},{"permissions":"rw-p","file_offset":"0x10000"}]
RESOURCE_COUNTS={"extension_audit":0,"find_spec":0,"create_module":0,"exec_module":0,"cached_requests":0,"function_attempts":0}
RESOURCE_SPEC=None
RESOURCE_MODULE=None
RESOURCE_RECEIPT=None
RESOURCE_CREATE=None
RESOURCE_EXEC=None
RESOURCE_PROFILE=None
RESOURCE_PROFILE_ORIGINAL=None
RESOURCE_MODULE_STATE=None
RESOURCE_SEARCH_ROOTS=None
RESOURCE_NEEDED=None
MAPPING_ROWS={}
ORIGINAL_IMPORT=None
NATIVE_ORIGINAL=None
ACTIVE_FINDER=None
START_ARGS = tuple(sys.argv)
MODE = START_ARGS[1] if len(START_ARGS)>1 else None
METHOD_FD = int(START_ARGS[2]) if MODE=="analysis" and len(START_ARGS)==5 and START_ARGS[2].isdigit() else None
PIPE_OPENS = 0
PRIVATE_OPENS = 0
PRIVATE_OPEN_ACTIVE = False
PRIVATE_FILE = None
CALLBACK_STATE = "absent"
CALLBACK_COUNT = 0
ENTERED_NAMES = set()
MODULE_BUDGET = None
STARTED_UTC = None
EVENTS = {"write_attempts": 0, "network_attempts": 0, "process_attempts": 0,
          "cache_write_attempts": 0, "native_requests": 0, "optional_requests": 0}
PHASE = "stdlib"
ASSET_PHASE = None
ASSETS = set()
ASSET_OPENS = {"initial-inventory":0,"pre-import-drift":0,"pre-analysis-drift":0,"final-drift":0}
INVENTORY_COUNTS = {}
IMPORT_OWNER = None
PYELFTOOLS_NATIVE_REQUESTS = 0
ALLOWED_PRIVATE = None
def audit_refuse(message):
    global REFUSAL_FLAG
    REFUSAL_FLAG=True
    raise RuntimeError(message)
def audit(event, args):
    global PIPE_OPENS
    if event=="import" and args and args[0]=="resource" and PHASE!="stdlib" and IMPORT_OWNER!="stdlib-resource":
        audit_refuse("resource rediscovery or reinitialization")
    if event=="import" and len(args)>1 and isinstance(args[1],str) and args[1].endswith(".so") and PHASE!="stdlib":
        if IMPORT_OWNER!="stdlib-resource" or args[0]!="resource" or args[1]!=RESOURCE_PATH or RESOURCE_COUNTS["extension_audit"]!=0:
            audit_refuse("nonfrozen or repeated extension load")
        RESOURCE_COUNTS["extension_audit"]+=1
    if event == "open":
        name, mode, flags = args
        writing = (isinstance(mode, str) and any(c in mode for c in "wax+")) or (isinstance(flags, int) and flags & 3 != 0) or (isinstance(flags, int) and flags & (64|512|1024))
        if writing:
            EVENTS["write_attempts"] += 1
            if str(name).endswith(".pyc"): EVENTS["cache_write_attempts"] += 1
            audit_refuse("filesystem write refused")
        if isinstance(name,int) and MODE=="analysis" and name==METHOD_FD and PIPE_OPENS==0:
            PIPE_OPENS+=1
            return
        if name==ALLOWED_PRIVATE and not PRIVATE_OPEN_ACTIVE:
            audit_refuse("private opener capability required")
        if PHASE=="callback" and name!=ALLOWED_PRIVATE:
            audit_refuse("callback filesystem access refused")
        if not isinstance(name, str) or not (name.startswith("/usr/lib/") or name.startswith("/usr/local/lib/") or name == sys.executable or name == "/proc/self/maps" or name == ALLOWED_PRIVATE):
            audit_refuse("unexpected read refused")
        if name in ASSETS:
            if ASSET_PHASE not in ASSET_OPENS: audit_refuse("inert asset open outside inventory")
            ASSET_OPENS[ASSET_PHASE] += 1
        if ("/capstone/" in name or "/elftools/" in name) and name.endswith(".pyc"):
            audit_refuse("decoder bytecode refused")
    if event.startswith(("socket.", "urllib.", "http.")):
        EVENTS["network_attempts"] += 1
        audit_refuse("network refused")
    if event.startswith(("subprocess.", "os.system", "os.exec", "os.spawn", "os.fork")):
        EVENTS["process_attempts"] += 1
        audit_refuse("process refused")
    if event in ("os.remove","os.rename","os.mkdir","os.rmdir","os.chmod","os.chown","os.truncate","os.link","os.symlink","os.utime"):
        EVENTS["write_attempts"] += 1
        audit_refuse("filesystem mutation refused")
    if event == "ctypes.dlopen" and IMPORT_OWNER == "pyelftools":
        audit_refuse("pyelftools native request refused")
    if event == "ctypes.dlopen" and args and args[0] in ASSETS:
        audit_refuse("inert asset native load")
    if event == "ctypes.dlopen" and PHASE != "stdlib":
        if PHASE != "decoder" or args != (NATIVE_PATH,) or EVENTS["native_requests"] != 1:
            audit_refuse("native discovery refused")
    if event == "import" and PHASE in ("sealed","callback"):
        if args[0] == "ccapstone" or args[0].split(".")[0] in ("capstone","elftools"):
            audit_refuse("post-boundary decoder import refused")
sys.addaudithook(audit)

import builtins
INITIAL_PROFILE=sys.getprofile()
ORIGINAL_IMPORT=builtins.__import__
INITIAL_META_PATH=tuple(sys.meta_path)
STATIC_CANDIDATES=[]
RESOURCE_DICTIONARY={}
POST_RESOURCE_MAP=None
POST_RESOURCE_ROWS=None
FIRST_CALLSITE_BYTES=None
FIRST_CALLSITE_SHA256=None
TERMINAL_LATCH=False
PROFILE_AUTO_UNSET=False
HANDLER_EXACT=False
FAILURE_CLASS="none"
PROPAGATION={k:False for k in ("profile-first-call","wrapper-entry","loader-after-exec","wrapped-import-return","outer-import-return")}
RESTORED={k:False for k in ("profile","import","native","finder","path","resource_create","resource_exec")}
class FirstResourceCall(BaseException):
    pass
def signal_terminal(route):
    if route not in PROPAGATION:raise RuntimeError("terminal route enum")
    PROPAGATION[route]=True
    raise FirstResourceCall()

try:
    import os, stat, pathlib, hashlib, json, csv, io, base64, struct, ast, marshal, ctypes
    import sysconfig, importlib.metadata, importlib.abc, importlib.util
    import re, datetime, bisect, collections, inspect, platform, ctypes.util, zlib, logging, types, fcntl, builtins, importlib.machinery
    from email.parser import Parser
    def require(ok, message):
        global REFUSAL_FLAG
        if not ok:
            REFUSAL_FLAG=True
            raise RuntimeError(message)
    def identity(path):
        p = pathlib.Path(path)
        s = p.lstat()
        require(stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and not p.is_symlink(), "nonregular or symlink component")
        require(p.is_absolute() and str(p.resolve()) == str(p), "noncanonical component")
        b = p.read_bytes()
        return {"path": str(p), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(), "size": len(b),
                "mode": stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode), "mtime_ns": s.st_mtime_ns}
    def forbidden_loaded():
        return [n for n in sys.modules if n in ("site","sitecustomize","usercustomize","ccapstone") or n.split(".")[0] in ("capstone","elftools")]
    require(sys.flags.isolated == 1 and sys.flags.no_site == 1 and sys.flags.dont_write_bytecode == 1, "nonisolated startup")
    require(sys.version_info[:3] == (3,12,3), "interpreter version")
    require(not forbidden_loaded(), "forbidden initial module")
    INTERPRETER = identity(sys.executable)
    ROOTS = sorted(set([sysconfig.get_path("purelib"),sysconfig.get_path("platlib"),"/usr/lib/python3/dist-packages"]))
    require(all(p.startswith(("/usr/lib/","/usr/local/lib/")) for p in ROOTS), "distribution root outside installed environment")
    RECORDS, SOURCES, MODULES, EXECUTED = {}, {}, {}, []
    DISTRIBUTIONS = {}
    def discover(distribution_name, package, version):
        ds = [d for d in importlib.metadata.distributions(path=ROOTS) if d.metadata["Name"].lower().replace("-","_") == distribution_name.lower().replace("-","_")]
        require(len(ds) == 1, "distribution count: " + distribution_name)
        d = ds[0]
        require(d.version == version, "distribution version: " + distribution_name)
        root = pathlib.Path(d.locate_file("")).resolve()
        require(str(root) in ROOTS, "distribution root")
        files = d.files
        require(files is not None, "missing distribution file inventory: " + distribution_name)
        rec = [f for f in files if str(f).endswith(".dist-info/RECORD")]
        require(len(rec) == 1, "missing or ambiguous RECORD: " + distribution_name)
        rp = pathlib.Path(d.locate_file(rec[0]))
        RECORDS[distribution_name] = identity(rp)
        rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(rp.read_text())))
        seen = set()
        for row in rows:
            require(len(row) == 3, "malformed RECORD")
            name,digest,size = row
            require(name not in seen, "duplicate RECORD origin")
            seen.add(name)
            if not name.startswith(package + "/") or not name.endswith(".py"): continue
            require(not pathlib.PurePosixPath(name).is_absolute() and ".." not in pathlib.PurePosixPath(name).parts, "source path escape")
            p = root / name
            ident = identity(p)
            require(digest.startswith("sha256=") and size.isdecimal(), "missing RECORD digest or size")
            expected = base64.urlsafe_b64decode(digest[7:] + "===")
            require(expected.hex() == ident["sha256"] and int(size) == ident["size"], "RECORD source mismatch")
            module = name[:-3].replace("/",".")
            is_package = module.endswith(".__init__")
            if is_package: module = module[:-9]
            require(module not in MODULES, "duplicate module origin")
            MODULES[module] = {"identity":ident,"package":is_package}
            SOURCES[module] = p.read_bytes()
        require(package in MODULES, "missing package source")
        DISTRIBUTIONS[distribution_name] = {"version":version,"root":str(root)}
    
    LEGACY = {}
    def checked_directory(path, root):
        p=pathlib.Path(path); r=pathlib.Path(root)
        require(p.is_absolute() and p.is_relative_to(r), "legacy root containment")
        for q in [r] + list(reversed(p.parents))[len(r.parents)+1:] + [p]:
            s=q.lstat()
            require(stat.S_ISDIR(s.st_mode) and not q.is_symlink(), "legacy directory symlink or kind")
        require(p.resolve()==p, "legacy noncanonical directory")
        return p
    def tree_inventory(path, root, metadata=False):
        base=checked_directory(path,root)
        out=[]; inodes=set(); folded=set(); files=0; sources=0; inert=0; bytecode=0
        caps=(768,512,384,128,64) if base.name=="elftools" else (512,256,96,64,192)
        def walk(p):
            nonlocal files,sources,inert,bytecode
            for child in sorted(p.iterdir(),key=lambda q:q.name):
                rel=str(child.relative_to(base))
                require(len(out)<(32 if metadata else caps[0]),"legacy entry cap")
                require(rel.casefold() not in folded,"legacy case-fold collision")
                folded.add(rel.casefold())
                s=child.lstat(); ino=(s.st_dev,s.st_ino)
                require(ino not in inodes and not child.is_symlink(),"legacy inode duplication or symlink")
                inodes.add(ino)
                require(child.resolve()==child and child.is_relative_to(base),"legacy path escape")
                item={"name":rel,"mode":stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode),"mtime_ns":s.st_mtime_ns,"size":s.st_size,"device":s.st_dev,"inode":s.st_ino}
                if stat.S_ISDIR(s.st_mode):
                    item["kind"]="directory";out.append(item);walk(child);continue
                require(stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode),"legacy nonregular entry")
                files+=1
                require(s.st_nlink==1,"legacy hard link")
                require(metadata or files<=caps[1],"package regular-file cap")
                require(not s.st_mode&0o111,"legacy executable file")
                if metadata:
                    require(files<=16,"legacy metadata file cap")
                    item["kind"]="metadata";item["identity"]=identity(child)
                elif child.suffix==".py":
                    sources+=1;require(sources<=caps[2],"legacy source cap")
                    item["kind"]="source";item["identity"]=identity(child)
                    sig=signature(child.read_bytes()[:16],child.suffix)
                    require(sig["prefix_class"] not in ("ELF","ZIP","gzip","bzip2","xz","bytecode"),"source signature conflict")
                elif child.suffix==".pyc" and "__pycache__" in child.relative_to(base).parts[:-1]:
                    bytecode+=1;require(bytecode<=caps[3],"stat-only bytecode cap")
                    item["kind"]="ignored-bytecode-stat-only"
                else:
                    inert+=1;require(inert<=caps[4],"inert asset cap")
                    ASSETS.add(str(child))
                    item["kind"]="inert-asset";item["identity"]=identity(child)
                    with child.open("rb") as stream: prefix=stream.read(16)
                    item["classification"]=signature(prefix,child.suffix)
                out.append(item)
        walk(base)
        if not metadata: INVENTORY_COUNTS[base.name]={"entries":len(out),"regular_files":files,"sources":sources,"inert":inert,"stat_only_bytecode":bytecode}
        return out
    def signature(prefix,suffix):
        kind="opaque"
        if prefix.startswith(b"\x7fELF"): kind="ELF"
        elif prefix.startswith((b"PK\x03\x04",b"PK\x05\x06",b"PK\x07\x08")): kind="ZIP"
        elif prefix.startswith(b"\x1f\x8b"): kind="gzip"
        elif prefix.startswith(b"BZh"): kind="bzip2"
        elif prefix.startswith(b"\xfd7zXZ\x00"): kind="xz"
        elif prefix.startswith(b"#!"): kind="script"
        elif len(prefix)>=4 and prefix[2:4]==b"\r\n": kind="bytecode"
        return {"prefix_class":kind,"suffix":suffix}
    def discover_legacy(distribution_name,package_name,version):
        global ASSET_PHASE
        require(not ENTRY_GATE,"package discovery after pre-entry gate")
        ds=[d for d in importlib.metadata.distributions(path=ROOTS) if d.metadata["Name"].lower().replace("_","-")==distribution_name.lower().replace("_","-")]
        require(len(ds)==1 and ds[0].version==version,"legacy distribution identity")
        d=ds[0];root=pathlib.Path(d.locate_file(""))
        require(str(root) in ROOTS,"legacy installed root")
        checked_directory(root,root)
        md=pathlib.Path(d._path)
        require(md.is_relative_to(root),"legacy metadata root")
        metadata_tree=tree_inventory(md,root,True)
        candidates=[x for x in metadata_tree if x["name"] in ("METADATA","PKG-INFO")]
        require(len(candidates)==1,"legacy metadata name/version source")
        from email.parser import Parser
        parsed=Parser().parsestr((md/candidates[0]["name"]).read_text())
        require(parsed["Name"].lower().replace("_","-")==distribution_name.lower().replace("_","-") and parsed["Version"]==version,"legacy parsed metadata disagreement")
        package=root/package_name
        ASSET_PHASE="initial-inventory"
        try: package_tree=tree_inventory(package,root)
        finally: ASSET_PHASE=None
        for item in package_tree:
            if item["kind"]!="source":continue
            rel=item["name"];parts=pathlib.PurePosixPath(rel).parts
            require(all((package/pathlib.Path(*parts[:i])/"__init__.py").is_file() for i in range(len(parts))),"legacy namespace package")
            module=package_name+"."+rel[:-3].replace("/",".")
            is_package=module.endswith(".__init__")
            if is_package:module=module[:-9]
            require(module not in MODULES,"legacy module collision")
            MODULES[module]={"identity":item["identity"],"package":is_package}
            SOURCES[module]=(package/rel).read_bytes()
        require(package_name in MODULES,"legacy missing package initializer")
        LEGACY[distribution_name]={"metadata_path":str(md),"package_path":str(package),"root":str(root),"metadata_tree":metadata_tree,"package_tree":package_tree,"provenance":distribution_name+"-direct-installed-source-not-RECORD","distribution_file_inventory_none":d.files is None}
        DISTRIBUTIONS[distribution_name]={"version":version,"root":str(root),"provenance":distribution_name+"-direct-installed-source-not-RECORD"}
    def legacy_unchanged(phase):
        global ASSET_PHASE
        require(phase in ("pre-import-drift","pre-analysis-drift","final-drift"),"unknown drift phase")
        ASSET_PHASE=phase
        try: return all(tree_inventory(item["metadata_path"],item["root"],True)==item["metadata_tree"] and tree_inventory(item["package_path"],item["root"])==item["package_tree"] for item in LEGACY.values())
        finally: ASSET_PHASE=None
    
    def snapshot():
        # Keep full parsed rows only in this process; never serialize or hash them.
        rows=[]
        with open("/proc/self/maps",encoding="utf-8",errors="strict") as stream:
            for line in stream:
                fields=line.rstrip("\n").split(maxsplit=5)
                require(len(fields) in (5,6),"malformed mapping field count")
                region,perms,offset,device,inode=fields[:5]
                name=fields[5] if len(fields)==6 else ""
                require(re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]+-[0-9a-f]+",region) is not None,"mapping range format")
                start,end=(int(x,16) for x in region.split("-"))
                require(0<=start<end<=2**64,"mapping range bounds")
                require(not rows or start>=rows[-1][1],"mapping range ordering")
                require(re.fullmatch(r"[r-][w-][x-][ps]",perms) is not None,"mapping permissions")
                require(re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]+",offset) is not None,"mapping offset")
                require(re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]+:[0-9a-f]+",device) is not None,"mapping device")
                require(inode.isdecimal(),"mapping inode")
                if name.startswith("["):
                    require(name.endswith("]"),"malformed bracketed mapping")
                    encoded=name.encode("utf-8",errors="strict")
                    require(len(encoded)<=256,"overlength bracketed mapping")
                elif name:
                    require(name.startswith("/") and not name.endswith(" (deleted)"),"relative or deleted mapping")
                rows.append((start,end,perms,int(offset,16),tuple(int(x,16) for x in device.split(":")),int(inode),name))
        require(bool(rows),"empty maps")
        return rows
    
    VDSO_BASE=None
    PSEUDO_BASE=None
    MAP_CHECKS=[]
    STDLIB_FILES={}
    def stdlib_inventory():
        result={}
        for module in list(sys.modules.values()):
            for attr in ("__file__","__cached__"):
                value=getattr(module,attr,None)
                if value and os.path.isfile(value):
                    require(value.startswith(("/usr/lib/","/usr/local/lib/")),"stdlib origin outside installed environment")
                    result[value]=identity(value)
        return result
    def maps(stage):
        global VDSO_BASE,PSEUDO_BASE,MAPPING_ROWS
        rows=snapshot()
        pseudo=[r for r in rows if not r[6].startswith("/")]
        executable=[r for r in pseudo if "x" in r[2]]
        require(len(pseudo)<=32 and len(executable)==1,"executable pseudo-map count")
        row=executable[0]
        require(row[6]=="[vdso]" and row[2]=="r-xp" and row[1]-row[0]==4096 and row[3]==0 and row[4]==(0,0) and row[5]==0,"nonadmitted executable pseudo-map tuple")
        if stage=="stdlib-baseline":
            require(VDSO_BASE is None,"duplicate mapping baseline")
            VDSO_BASE=row;PSEUDO_BASE=tuple(r for r in pseudo if "x" not in r[2])
        else:
            require(VDSO_BASE==row,"vDSO full-row/address drift")
        nonexec=tuple(r for r in pseudo if "x" not in r[2])
        MAP_CHECKS.append({"stage":stage,"vdso_full_row_equal":True,"nonexecuting_pseudo_rows":len(nonexec),"nonexecuting_rows_equal_to_baseline":nonexec==PSEUDO_BASE})
        result={};MAPPING_ROWS={}
        for row in rows:
            name=row[6]
            if not name.startswith("/"):continue
            require(name not in ASSETS,"inert asset mapped in guarded process")
            result[name]=identity(name)
            MAPPING_ROWS.setdefault(name,[]).append({"permissions":row[2],"file_offset":hex(row[3])})
        rows.clear()
        require(len(result)<=128,"native component cap")
        return result
    def needed(path):
        b = pathlib.Path(path).read_bytes()
        require(b[:6] == b"\x7fELF\x02\x01", "native ELF format")
        h = struct.unpack_from("<16sHHIQQQIHHHHHH",b)
        phoff,phsize,phnum = h[5],h[9],h[10]
        require(h[2] == 183 and phsize == 56, "native ELF machine or phentsize")
        ph = [struct.unpack_from("<IIQQQQQQ",b,phoff+i*phsize) for i in range(phnum)]
        dyn = [p for p in ph if p[0] == 2]
        require(len(dyn)==1, "native dynamic table count")
        p=dyn[0]; require(p[2]+p[5]<=len(b) and p[5]%16==0,"native dynamic bounds")
        entries=[]
        for off in range(p[2],p[2]+p[5],16):
            t,v=struct.unpack_from("<qQ",b,off)
            if t==0: break
            entries.append((t,v))
        else: raise RuntimeError("unterminated native dynamic table")
        tables=[v for t,v in entries if t==5]; sizes=[v for t,v in entries if t==10]
        require(len(tables)==len(sizes)==1,"native string table")
        va,sz=tables[0],sizes[0]
        loads=[p for p in ph if p[0]==1 and p[3]<=va and va+sz<=p[3]+p[5]]
        require(len(loads)==1,"native string mapping")
        off=loads[0][2]+va-loads[0][3]; strings=b[off:off+sz]; names=[]
        for t,v in entries:
            if t!=1: continue
            end=strings.find(b"\0",v)
            require(0<=v<end<len(strings),"native dependency string")
            names.append(strings[v:end].decode("ascii"))
        return names
    class SourceLoader(importlib.abc.Loader):
        def create_module(self,spec): return None
        def exec_module(self,module):
            name=module.__name__
            require(ENTRY_GATE and name in MODULES and name not in ENTERED_NAMES and MODULE_BUDGET==77 and len(EXECUTED)<MODULE_BUDGET,"module map, duplicate entry or cap")
            ENTERED_NAMES.add(name)
            item=MODULES[name]; path=item["identity"]["path"]
            require(identity(path)==item["identity"],"source drift")
            code=compile(SOURCES[name],path,"exec",dont_inherit=True,optimize=0)
            record={"module":name,"source":item["identity"],"code_sha256":hashlib.sha256(marshal.dumps(code)).hexdigest(),"state":"entered"}
            EXECUTED.append(record)
            module.__file__=path
            if item["package"]: module.__path__=[]
            exec(code,module.__dict__)
            if TERMINAL_LATCH: signal_terminal("loader-after-exec")
            record["state"]="completed"
    class TerminalFinder(importlib.abc.MetaPathFinder):
        def find_spec(self,fullname,path=None,target=None):
            if fullname=="resource":
                require(IMPORT_OWNER=="stdlib-resource" and RESOURCE_SPEC is not None and target is None and RESOURCE_COUNTS["find_spec"]==0,"resource spec rediscovery")
                RESOURCE_COUNTS["find_spec"]+=1
                return RESOURCE_SPEC
            if fullname=="ccapstone":
                EVENTS["optional_requests"]+=1
                raise ImportError("optional decoder explicitly refused")
            if fullname.split(".")[0] in ("capstone","elftools"):
                require(PHASE=="decoder" and fullname in MODULES,"unmapped or late decoder import")
                return importlib.util.spec_from_loader(fullname,SourceLoader(),is_package=MODULES[fullname]["package"])
            return None
    
    def resource_object_state():
        require(RESOURCE_MODULE is not None and sys.modules.get("resource") is RESOURCE_MODULE,"resource module object replaced")
        require(RESOURCE_MODULE.__name__=="resource" and RESOURCE_MODULE.__file__==RESOURCE_PATH and RESOURCE_MODULE.__spec__ is RESOURCE_SPEC,"resource object name/file/spec")
        require(RESOURCE_MODULE.__spec__.origin==RESOURCE_PATH and RESOURCE_MODULE.__loader__ is RESOURCE_SPEC.loader and type(RESOURCE_SPEC.loader) is importlib.machinery.ExtensionFileLoader,"resource loader identity")
